name: Urban Canyon Baseline
description:
## Urban Canyon Baseline

A clean-signal reference run through a dense urban area. No interference is applied at any point.

This scenario establishes the **baseline GNSS performance** of the vehicle receiver under challenging multipath conditions caused by tall buildings. Use the collected data as the ground-truth reference for comparing degraded-signal scenarios.

**Route:** City centre ring road, approx. 4 km loop.

**Expected outcome:** Stable 3D fix throughout, HDOP < 2.5 in open sections, possible fix fluctuations in the canyon sections.

steps.driver_instructions:
**Park the vehicle** at the designated start point (open-sky parking area). Wait for the GNSS receiver to acquire a stable 3D fix with at least 6 satellites before proceeding.

Confirm in the TMI that the VDL is publishing data on the `tm/vdl` topic.

Drive **north** along the canyon section at a steady 30 km/h. Maintain a consistent speed — do not stop unless required by traffic.

Note any visible signal quality drops on the receiver display as you pass between tall buildings.

steps.summary: Urban canyon drive — south sector and return
steps.driver_instructions:
Continue the loop **south** and return to the start point. Maintain 30 km/h.

Once back at the start point, remain stationary for 15 seconds before signalling test completion.
